about: A command-line tool for working with CSV files.

prs.title: New CSV columns no longer get HTML codes in them
prs.broken: Building a column from a template escaped values as if they were web pages, so Tom & Jerry was written as Tom & Jerry with no warning.
prs.changed: The add command now fills templates as plain text, and the README says so.
prs.matters: New columns hold the same text as the source data.
